claim_scope: Outcome-conditioned consumed-development mechanism evidence. This is not a held-out, confirmatory, population-rate, statistical-significance, generalization, leaderboard, or SOTA result.

launcher.failure: Spark system Python lacked the openai provider-client dependency.

primary_endpoint.definition: The original scheduled episode passes only if its submitted program passes EnvBench Official.
primary_endpoint.interpretation: The original Ajenti episode remains Fail. Its failure is censored from algorithm-effect attribution only because the separately fixed exact candidate passed both corrected clean replay and Official evaluation.

mechanism.interpretation: Scheduled trusted observation coupled to atomic handoff removed the observed goal-to-delivery delay on all three selected cases. Replay counterexamples remained inside the active Agent session; they did not prescribe package or repair actions.

cases.repair_trace: The first complete environment timed out during replay. The second over-minimized installation with --no-deps and failed target imports. The same Agent restored full CPU-compatible dependencies and retained no-deps only for selected optional packages; the third clean replay and Official evaluation passed.

cases.terminal_failure: The old import-provider provenance check rejected ordinary wheel and operating-system-owned modules. The Agent then replaced a working environment, regressed from zero to 39 obligations, and exhausted 120 requests.

boundary_adjudication.decision: Keep the original episode Fail and censor it from algorithm-effect attribution; do not count the adjudication as a replacement treatment episode.

cases.repair_trace: Fresh replay exposed Git dubious ownership. Free choice was restored and the Agent voluntarily resubmitted on the next request with git safe.directory; clean replay and Official evaluation passed.

resources.interpretation: Tokens, time, requests, and provider errors are outcomes rather than hard success thresholds. Ajenti dominates cost because a faulty boundary rejected a valid candidate and induced destructive re-search.

retain_core: atomic handoff when the full goal passes
raw replay counterexample returned to the same session
scientific_decision.next_evidence: Freeze this coupled mechanism and evaluate it prospectively on an outcome-blind, repository-disjoint bad-case batch with matched F+O controls before any further algorithm change.
restrictions: Do not count Ajenti adjudication as a replacement treatment episode.
Do not estimate a population success rate from these three selected cases.
Do not isolate a pure handoff effect from this coupled scheduled-observation treatment.
Do not derive repository-specific package or command rules from these trajectories.
